title: Two Sum
statement: Given an array of integers nums and an integer target, return indices of the two numbers that add up to target.
hints: Use a hash map to store seen values.
solutionExplanation: Iterate once, checking if target - nums[i] has been seen before, using a hash map for O(1) lookups.
